name: research-skills-openai
description: Experimental personal preview of evidence-grounded research workflows for ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Personal research workflows for ChatGPT and Codex
interface.longDescription: An owner-operated personal preview for evidence mapping, research ideas, proposals, articles, perspectives, research-impact positioning, independent review, revision, and human-review packaging. It is experimental, carries no public-support or production-stability promise, and may change during the 0.x series.
defaultPrompt: Turn a research direction into an evidence-grounded idea portfolio.
Evaluate a proposal or build a reviewed manuscript package.
Reposition a completed study and compare bounded impact-enhancement strategies.
